import copy
import math
import unittest

from solution import attach_ratings


class AttachRatingsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_averages_filters_and_preserves_record_order(self):
        ratings = [
            {"record_id": "a", "score": 5},
            {"record_id": "b", "score": 2.0},
            {"record_id": "a", "score": 3.0},
            {"record_id": "c", "score": 4},
        ]
        records = [
            {"record_id": "c", "name": "third"},
            {"record_id": "missing", "name": "none"},
            {"record_id": "a", "name": "first"},
            {"record_id": "b", "name": "second"},
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            attach_ratings(ratings, records, minimum=3.0),
            [
                {"record_id": "c", "name": "third", "rating_average": 4.0},
                {"record_id": "a", "name": "first", "rating_average": 4.0},
            ],
        )

    def test_minimum_boundary_and_existing_average_is_replaced(self):
        ratings = [{"record_id": "x", "score": 3}]
        records = [{"record_id": "x", "rating_average": "stale", "extra": 1}]
        result = attach_ratings(ratings, records, minimum=3)
        self.assertEqual(result, [{"record_id": "x", "rating_average": 3.0, "extra": 1}])
        self.assertIs(type(result[0]["rating_average"]), float)

    def test_deep_copy_preserves_aliasing_within_each_record(self):
        shared = [1, {"nested": [2]}]
        record = {"record_id": "x", "left": shared, "right": shared}
        ratings = [{"record_id": "x", "score": 5}]
        result = attach_ratings(ratings, [record])
        copied = result[0]
        self.assertIs(copied["left"], copied["right"])
        self.assertIsNot(copied["left"], shared)
        self.assertIsNot(copied["left"][1], shared[1])
        copied["left"][1]["nested"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(shared, [1, {"nested": [2]}])

    def test_inputs_are_not_mutated_and_empty_inputs(self):
        ratings = [{"record_id": "x", "score": 4}]
        records = [{"record_id": "x", "data": {"v": 1}}]
        ratings_before = copy.deepcopy(ratings)
        records_before = copy.deepcopy(records)
        attach_ratings(ratings, records)
        self.assertEqual(ratings, ratings_before)
        self.assertEqual(records, records_before)
        self.assertEqual(attach_ratings([], []), [])
        self.assertEqual(attach_ratings([], records), [])

    def test_collection_type_errors(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            attach_ratings((), [])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            attach_ratings([], ())

    def test_malformed_ratings(self):
        cases = [
            [{"record_id": "x"}],
            [{"record_id": "x", "score": 4, "extra": 1}],
            [{"record_id": "", "score": 4}],
            [{"record_id": 1, "score": 4}],
            [{"record_id": "x", "score": True}],
            [{"record_id": "x", "score": -0.1}],
            [{"record_id": "x", "score": 5.1}],
            [{"record_id": "x", "score": math.nan}],
            ["bad"],
        ]
        for ratings in cases:
            with self.subTest(ratings=ratings), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                attach_ratings(ratings, [])

    def test_malformed_records_and_minimum(self):
        for records in ([{}], [{"record_id": ""}], [{"record_id": 3}], ["bad"]):
            with self.subTest(records=records), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                attach_ratings([], records)
        for minimum in (True, -1, 5.01, "3", math.nan, math.inf):
            with self.subTest(minimum=minimum), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                attach_ratings([], [], minimum=minimum)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
